title: OpenBrick3D Dimensional Standard
description: The Dimensional Standard (standards/dimensions-v1.json): one row per brick feature with its nominal size, LDraw size, print targets, confidence and source. Read by openbrick-units (crates/openbrick-units/src/standard.rs); see docs/plan/04. A 1.0 document may use only the fields named here ($defs/knownFields).

version.description: Version of the standard's content, separate from the schema pragma.

ldu_mm.description: Nominal millimetres per LDraw unit used for every conversion at the file boundary.

notes.description: Free text. Not read by openbrick-units yet.

features.description: Feature rows, looked up by id through STANDARD.get().mm(id). Ids must be unique; JSON Schema cannot say so, so cargo xtask data checks it.

tolerances.description: Measured manufacturing tolerances and their sources, as numbers or free-text ranges. Not read by openbrick-units yet.

knownFields.description: The fields schema 1.0 names, object by object; true means the value is checked by the main schema. Applied only to 1.0 documents (see atThisMinor), where any other field is an error: serde would drop it silently, so a misspelt optional field would change nothing. Objects not listed here are open on purpose. cargo xtask data checks that these lists match the properties the schema declares.

atThisMinor.description: Matches a document whose pragma names this schema's minor version, 1.0 (or a 1.0.x patch). Such a document may use only the fields this schema names ($defs/knownFields). A document of a later 1.x minor may carry fields added since; this schema checks the fields it knows and ignores the rest, so older tools can still read newer minors (docs/plan/08 section 9).

id.description: Stable snake_case id, the key code uses to read the value.

nominal_mm.description: Nominal design value in millimetres (a plain factor for unitless rows); null when the row has no length.

ldraw_ldu.description: The same feature as LDraw models it, in LDU; null when LDraw has no equivalent.

print_target.description: Starting print targets by process profile id, as free-text ranges; fit profiles override them.

confidence.description: verified: from a primary source or two independent measurements; likely: community consensus; inferred: neither (docs/plan/04 section 2).

source.description: Where the number comes from. Required: every geometry number cites its source (CLAUDE.md).

pragma.description: Schema version pragma: major 1 and a minor, optionally a patch (docs/plan/08 sections 1 and 9). Every 1.x is accepted: readers ignore fields from minors newer than they know, and this schema checks only the fields it names in documents newer than 1.0 (see atThisMinor).

semver.description: A Semantic Versioning 2.0.0 version (pattern from semver.org).

spdx.description: An SPDX licence id, or a simple AND, OR or WITH expression of ids (LICENSE-POLICY.md).

credit.description: Who made the document. Keeping it is a community norm, not a legal condition (LICENSE-POLICY.md).

provenance.description: Where the data came from, so attribution travels with it through conversion, export and printing (LICENSE-POLICY.md, docs/plan/06 section 2).

source.description: original, or the upstream file or project the data derives from.

profileId.description: A profile id: lower-case words joined by hyphens, where a word may hold dots, as in fdm-0.4 or resin-msla (docs/plan/05 section 3).
